label: rem:brings-geometric-connection
title: Bring's-surface geometric realisation
html: The geometric structures of the q-Laplacian, fermion--boson decomposition, and contact affine chart manifest concretely on the Bring surface. The contact structure \varTheta, Reeb vector field \xi, and substrate parameter q reduce to explicit formulas on a genus-4 Riemann surface with S_5 symmetry. The abstract equilibrium \Delta_q \alpha = 0 reduces to computable eigenvalue problems, and the boson--fermion split becomes a Hodge decomposition of the harmonic space.
